questions.question: How many users does checkout-assistant have?
questions.answer: Cannot answer. User count not recorded for checkout-assistant. Traces carry no user ID or session ID. Only root-span attribute on sampled trace: `customer.segment` (value `smb`). Segment label, not user identity, so distinct users cannot be counted. Traces are not users; one user can start many.
